title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 15, 2026, relative to the Renewal of the Master
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 15, 2026, relative to the Renewal of the Master
  Service Agreement Between the City of Los Angeles and Axon Enterprise, Inc. for Body-Worn
  Cameras, Taser 10, Fleet In-Car Video, and Related Public Safety Technology Services, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-284]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor and City Council.
summary: Approval and transmission to City Council of Master Service Agreement renewal with Axon Enterprise for body-worn cameras, Tasers, in-car video, and related public safety technology.
